name: Bikano all time mixture 250g(25)
ingredients_raw: Edible Vegetable Oil (Refined Palmolein Oil, Refined Ricebran Oil, Refined Cottonseed Oil), Chickpea Flour (21%), Rice Flakes (13.9%), Cornflakes (13.5%), Peanuts (9.5%), Sugar (Sucrose), Rice Flour, Split Bengal Gram, Curry Leaves, Husked Dew Moth Bean Flour, Iodized Salt, Carom Seeds, Red Chilli Powder, Turmeric, Yellow Chilli Powder, Black Salt, Raising Agent [E 500 (ii)], Acidity Regulator (E 330).
